text:
The process is awful and drains you so much.. I am pretty sure the process broke a lot of couples by itself. 
The job market is very very tough right now, lot of people got fired recently in tech. 
In terms of integration, depends on what you were looking for, I already lived abroad before and found amazing international communities and very opened but here it’s really tough, the vibe is just very different than what I found and even in olim group, Hebrew comes back very quickly and it’s hard if you do not speak.. maybe it’s also because we are not Jewish and you can feel it sometimes in the olim groups but again depends on who you meet etc. On a personal point I thought it would be way way easier on every aspects..
